answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a cipher spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Producing 83 answers an epoch as a result costs 65 real forward passes, and the falcon record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a basalt header. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
